Provision of Technical Inspection Services
Article (2)
A Centre must provide technical inspection services, and the other services specified in Article (7) of the above-mentioned Executive Council Resolution No. (1) of 2026, in accordance with the relevant appointment-booking system approved by the RTA.

Functions of the RTA
Article (5)
Without prejudice to the functions vested in the Competent Enti ties, the RTA will have the duties and powers to: 1. develop the policies and strategic plans required to enhance the efficiency, operation, and development of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate; 2. define the categories and types of Autonomous Vehicles in accor dance with the standards, specifications, and rules prescribed by the Competent Entities; 3. approve and regularly review the technical, operational, security, safety, and Operator performance standards that must be met in order for Autonomous Vehicles to travel on Roads; 4.
